queue_history.py timeline.md: ERCOT's OWN queue milestones show 'Approved for Synchronization' achieved 2025-10-01 and 'Approved for Energization' achieved 2025-08-27 -- independently corroborates the EIA-860M operating date (2025-10) from a third data source (ERCOT's own milestone gates, not just the developer's COD claim)

reasoning_evidence: Site is ALREADY BUILT AND OPERATING, not still in a construction ramp: satellite imagery (2026-07-20) shows a complete solar array matching the Ch313 boundary map shape exactly; EIA-860M plant 68458 reports status (OP) Operating with actual operating date 2025-10, continuously through the newest 2026-05 snapshot

ERCOT's own queue milestone timeline (queue_history.py) shows Approved for Energization 2025-08-27 and Approved for Synchronization 2025-10-01 -- a THIRD independent source (ERCOT's own gates, distinct from both the developer's COD claim and EIA) placing commercial operability in Q4 2025

The signed IA's own contractual Scheduled Commercial Operation Date is 2026-06-30 (unchanged across original IA and both amendments) -- notably LATER than the queue's reported claim of 2026-04-30, and both are moot: the plant appears to have reached commercial operation ~8 months before either paper date, which is a favorable (ahead-of-schedule) drift, not a slip

Queue-history COD drift (timeline.md): 6 changes across 47 monthly snapshots, holding at 2026-06-30 for the longest single stretch (2023-09 to 2025-06, matching the IA), then dropping to 2026-01-30 and finally 2026-04-30 as the ERCOT report likely lagged behind actual completion -- the LATEST queue snapshot (2026-06-01) had not yet been updated to reflect commercial-operation-approved status despite Approved-for-Synchronization since 2025-10

Independent estimate: COD already effectively achieved in 2025-Q4 (Oct 2025), evidenced by imagery + EIA + ERCOT's own sync/energization gates converging on the same quarter; drift risk LOW because this is a completed-project confirmation, not a forward projection -- the only open question is the exact commercial-operation-approved paperwork date, which the queue snapshot had not yet recorded as of 2026-06-01
